correctness.rationale: For \(n\ge1\), base \(2\) is not palindromic, so \(b(2^n)=3\) is equivalent to ternary palindromicity. The verifier represents each \(2^n\) exactly in base \(3^{39}\), proves no candidate can be discarded unless its first and reversed last 12 ternary digits disagree, and performs a complete exact palindrome comparison on every survivor. It scans every \(1\le n\le10^6\) and returns exactly \(\{1,2,3,4\}\).
